But your company just announced that you will be back to the office soon. So, I placed an order a little while ago—three home office items plus some hiking gear—because I was all set to work remotely from my parents’ place in Seattle and live my best outdoorsy life. Of course, my company just announced we’re all heading back to the office, so those office items are now about as useful as a screen door on a submarine.

If it’s possible to cancel or return just the home office part of the order—and I’ll be honest, I can’t even remember exactly what the three items were—I’d like to do that and keep the hiking stuff. Could you let me know how much I’d get refunded, and make sure it goes back to my original payment method?

If partial cancellation isn’t allowed, then no big deal, I’ll just keep the whole order—but in that case I’d want to update my default profile address to the Seattle house that’s already on the order. I’d rather not type out that address here, if that’s okay.
